tools.name: voice_speak
tools.description: Say a line aloud in your voice through the person's speakers, or only synthesize it when silent is true. Use it when the person asks for voice, when this line needs a specific emotion or voice, or when automatic reading is off. It only makes sound; the visible reply still goes through the channel's own send tool. When the backend supports paralinguistic tags, keep them inline in the text: [Laughter], [Sigh], [Breathing], [Uhm], [Question-ei] and the like are performed, not read out.

emotion.description: Emotion for this line, for example 开心、温柔、疲惫. Omit to use the standing style.

instruct.description: Natural-language direction for this line, for example "像在耳边轻声说话，语速偏慢". Omit to use the standing style.

voice.description: Voice id for this line. Omit to use the configured voice.

speed.description: Speed multiplier for this line; 1 is normal.

silent.description: true synthesizes without playing on this computer; use it for a line meant for another channel.

summary.zh: 现在念一句;可指定情绪、表演指令、音色与语速,也可以只合成不出声。
summary.en: Say one line now, optionally with an emotion, direction, voice and speed, or synthesize it silently.

tools.name: voice_sing
tools.description: Sing a lyric line through the configured singing plugin. It only makes sound; the visible reply still goes through the channel's own send tool. If no singing plugin is configured, or it is not ready, the call fails instead of speaking the lyrics.

summary.zh: 把一句歌词交给唱歌插件唱出来。
summary.en: Sing one lyric line through the configured singing service.

tools.name: voice_hush
tools.description: Stop the voice now: the line playing is cut and queued lines are dropped. It does not affect the visible reply.

summary.en: Stop the voice and drop queued lines.

tools.name: voice_style
tools.description: Read or change the standing voice style used by automatic reading. Call with values to change them; call with no arguments to read the current style. Changes are saved to the World configuration and apply to later lines.

emotion.description: Standing emotion; an empty string clears it.

instruct.description: Standing natural-language direction; an empty string clears it.

summary.zh: 读或改自动朗读使用的长期音色与情绪。
summary.en: Read or change the standing voice style used by automatic reading.

description.zh: 一段语音合成完成,带音频附件;只归档,供播放类插件取用。
description.en: One spoken chunk finished, with its audio attachment; archived only for playback plugins.

description.zh: 合成或播放失败;只归档,供排查。
description.en: Synthesis or playback failed; archived only for diagnosis.

prompts.title: 语音 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
语音由 Voice 提供:文字在本机合成并从扬声器念出来。它只负责声音,不负责把回复发到聊天渠道;可见的回复仍走原来的发送工具。

自动朗读现在是 {{voice.auto}}(协议 {{voice.backend}},音色 {{voice.voice}},情绪 {{voice.emotion}},指令 {{voice.instruct}},唱歌服务 {{voice.sing}})。自动朗读开着时,普通回复不必调用任何语音工具;关着时,想出声就调用 voice_speak。

需要出声的时候:
- 对方明确要语音、要你念出来、要听你的声音时,调用 voice_speak,把要念的正文放进 text。这会绕过概率,必定出声。
- 这一句需要特定情绪、语气、音色或语速时,调用 voice_speak 并填对应参数;之后想保持这种语气,调用 voice_style 把它变成长期风格,它影响之后的自动朗读。
- 某一句只想合成、不在本机播放(例如要交给别的渠道发语音条)时,voice_speak 带 silent: true。
- 想唱一句时调用 voice_sing;自动来源的正文以【唱】开头也会转给唱歌插件。唱歌服务没配时会回失败,不要改写成普通朗读。
- 对方让你安静、停下时调用 voice_hush。

文本规则:
- text 只放真正要念的正文,不要放动作描写、Markdown、代码、网址或解释。
- 后端支持副语言标签时,可以在正文里保留 [Laughter]、[Sigh]、[Breathing]、[Uhm]、[Question-ei] 这类标签,它们会被演出来,不会被念出字面;不确定后端是否支持就不要加。
- 不要把控制标记写进可见的回复正文;语音参数只放在工具调用里。

changelog.0.1.0:
- 初版:协议无关的 TTS World,内置 audiocpp / OpenAI 兼容 / custom JSON 三种适配器。
- 触发:工具、显式关键词、`<tts>` 标记、助手正文、工具参数、事件轮询;自动朗读按概率。
- 情绪与标签:instruct / categorical / basic / tags / none 五种模式;副语言标签按后端保留或删除。
- 文本过滤与切句;本机播放、事件出口、tool 附件三种输出;本地语音 HTTP 接口;唱歌插件 HTTP 联动。
